events.title: Hubble launches into orbit
events.description: The space telescope leaves Earth aboard Discovery. Its first images later reveal a flaw in the main mirror.

events.title: The Soviet Union breaks apart
events.description: Gorbachev resigns as Soviet president. Independent states take the place of the union.

events.title: Web software becomes free to use
events.description: CERN releases its World Wide Web software into the public domain, helping others build on it.

what_happened_next.text:
Coca-Cola led these choices over five years. Exxon and the US share basket gained less, while Sony and the international basket rose only modestly. Sony's purchase of a film studio was a dramatic business story, but it did not make Sony the best investment in this set.

The Berlin Wall had already opened when you started, so that event belongs to your starting information. Later, the Soviet Union broke apart. Hubble launched in 1990, and CERN opened its web software to everyone in 1993. Big changes kept arriving during the holding period.

Buying another business can create opportunities, but it also brings costs and challenges. A large deal is therefore not the same thing as a guaranteed gain for shareholders. The return still depends on what happens after the purchase and on the price investors paid.

These results belong to one starting date and one five-year window. They do not prove that drinks always beat electronics, or that buying film studios is always a mistake. Keep the specific outcome separate from a sweeping rule.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: The Berlin Wall had opened, financial oversight was under scrutiny, and Sony was expanding into Hollywood.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: Returns depended on the full investment path, not the size of a headline. A large acquisition was a business decision whose investment result still had to unfold.
reflection.what_faded_away: The excitement of a Hollywood deal did not tell you the eventual winner. A widely reported event was not the same as a useful price forecast.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: The web’s growth and the Soviet Union’s breakup were still ahead. Even with that history revealed, the exact investment ranking would have been hard to predict.
